name: Rusizi National Park
subtitle: A protected wetland park on the Rusizi River north of Bujumbura, home to hippopotamuses and Nile crocodiles.

facts.label: Hippo poaching (2014 report)
facts.value: Eight hippos killed in under three months; senior warden says locals trap them for meat.

facts.label: Crocodiles (2014)
facts.value: Warden reported a single Nile crocodile left in the park.

parts.text: A protected wetland park on the Rusizi River north of Bujumbura, home to hippopotamuses and Nile crocodiles. Its wildlife has been under pressure from poaching.
